legal_basis.paye_bands_non_resident: Income Tax Act (Cap 338), Schedule 4 Part II - not amended in 2026
legal_basis.corporation_tax: Income Tax Act (Cap 338), s.6 and Schedule 4
legal_basis.capital_gains_corporate: Income Tax Act (Cap 338), s.18 - gains included in gross income
legal_basis.rental_tax_individual_threshold: Income Tax Act (Cap 338), s.5 annual threshold
legal_basis.rental_tax_company: Income Tax Act (Cap 338), s.22(1)(c) expense cap
legal_basis.withholding_royalty: Income Tax Act (Cap 338), s.83 - rate not amended in 2026
legal_basis.withholding_public_entertainer: Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2026, s.16 inserting s.135B; Schedule 4 Part XVI
legal_basis.withholding_betting_winnings: Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2026, s.14 substituting s.131; Schedule 4 Part XI
legal_basis.withholding_foreign_interest: Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2026, s.20(b); Schedule 4 Part 2 para 2A (s.82(5) debenture interest)
legal_basis.withholding_telecom_commission: Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2026, s.20(e) substituting Schedule 4 Part XIII (s.133)

legal_basis.customs_duty_common: EAC Common External Tariff - finished goods band
legal_basis.environmental_levy_used_clothing: Excise Duty (Amendment) Act 2026 - worn clothing imports, share of CIF value

notes.paye_bands_resident: Schedule 4 Part I states ANNUAL chargeable income; these are the monthly equivalents (annual divided by 12). The Act's table is: nil up to UGX 4,020,000; 20% of the excess over 4,020,000 up to 4,920,000; UGX 180,000 plus 25% of the excess over 4,920,000 up to 5,820,000; UGX 405,000 plus 30% of the excess over 5,820,000 up to 120,000,000; above 120,000,000 the same plus an additional 10% of the excess over 120,000,000. The top band is expressed here as a single 40% marginal rate.
notes.paye_bands_non_resident: The 2026 Act substitutes only Schedule 4 Part I, which by its terms applies to resident individuals. Part II (non-residents) is not amended, so the Cap 338 rates continue to apply.
notes.withholding_royalty: The 2026 Act amends only the s.2 definition of 'royalty' (inserting 'software'); it does not change the rate. The 15% here is the pre-existing Cap 338 rate and has not been reconciled against s.83 directly.
notes.withholding_non_business_asset: Applies to a person who purchases a non-business asset (s.130(3)). Distinct from the 6% on services and goods under s.119.
notes.withholding_telecom_commission: Commission paid by a telecommunications service provider for telecom retail services, mobile network services or mobile money services.
notes.rental_tax_individual: The 2026 Act (s.12, inserting s.124(1a)) lets an individual liable to rental tax file a provisional return monthly. The rate and annual threshold are unchanged.
notes.vat_registration_threshold_annual: Businesses below UGX 300,000,000 annual turnover are no longer required to register; voluntary registration remains available.
notes.customs_duty_common: Indicative EAC CET band for finished consumer goods. The binding rate is the tariff line for the specific HS code.
